outcome: Vertical transmission of COVID-19 to neonates
cohort: The cohort consisted of 82 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 and their 82 neonates in a South Indian tertiary care center.
finding: The incidence of vertical transmission of COVID-19 from mother to neonate was low (3.6%), and maternal COVID-19 status did not affect breastfeeding rates at discharge and 3 months of age.
cross-section timing: During the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic from July 1, 2020, to January 31, 2021.
